gen-vast-shadow-gf-domine: Domine has tall lowercase tucked under compact ascenders, with curves that hold open space and a slight pinch at each stem. Beneath Vast Shadow's compass-drawn headings, extended reading goes dignified and unhurried.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-esteban: Vast Shadow cuts every stroke to a single width, while Esteban's strokes shift like gently tapered glass rods. But extended reading in Esteban stays easy going, its open e never squeezed shut.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-faustina: Vast Shadow holds each stroke to one thickness like a drawn cable, vintage and eye-catching. Yet Faustina's best quality is its lightly modulated stroke, which never produces a harsh thin spot.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-halant: Halant stands tall, its x-height towering and its terminals pointing outward. Vast Shadow gets attention with a marker-like vintage line, while Halant does the steadier work of showing a faint stroke contrast.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-hedvig-letters-serif: Classic in feel, Hedvig Letters Serif has open-ended curves and a tall, sturdy lowercase under Vast Shadow's unmodulated, vintage stroke. And the standout quality is a tempered contrast that neither jolts nor flattens.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-marcellus-sc: Dignified and literary, Marcellus SC pulls its terminals well back and modulates its strokes gently. Whereas Vast Shadow replaces hairline joins with full-width connections, Marcellus SC keeps a medium-key contrast.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-montagu-slab: Montagu Slab has a friendly, mild contrast between robust downstrokes and slender turns, plus a sizable x-height. Vast Shadow handles the vintage show-off work, with thin-looking letters that have no thinner parts.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-ovo: Ovo keeps a tall middle band with shallow ascenders and descenders. Vast Shadow is best at its laser-cut, single-width vintage look, while Ovo is best at thins only slightly lighter than its thicks.
gen-zen-dots-gf-hepta-slab: Friendly Zen Dots leaves lots of room around every letter, with generous openings at every weight. Hepta Slab's standout quality is a bent-paperclip line with no thick-thin shifts and stretched words.
gen-zen-dots-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Spread wide and slow, the body text reads literary beneath the friendly, tech-flavored Zen Dots. Padyakke Expanded One is worth giving a larger size, since every round bowl is traced with one marker.
